description: Sample hybrid bolt responses. If a hybrid bolt is created using the sel hybrid create command, then the nodes of each element so created will be ordered such that the overall bolt direction goes from the first point to the second point (i.e., the nodal connectivity of each element will be ordered such that the direction from end-1 to end-2 corresponds with the direction from the begin point to the end point).

keywords.name: cable-state
keywords.description: Get tensile yield state of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

keywords.name: force
keywords.description: Get average axial force in the element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

keywords.name: grout-slip
keywords.description: Get slip in grout (shear coupling spring) at end of the element. Sign convention is +/- with respect to the average axial direction of hybrid.

keywords.name: grout-stress
keywords.description: Get stress in grout (shear coupling spring) at end of the element. Sign convention is +/- with respect to the average axial direction of hybrid.

keywords.name: stress
keywords.description: Get axial stress in the element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

keywords.name: kwd:position
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by ( v ) coordinates (the nearest element is taken). If this keyword is used, element-id , node-id , and dowel-id should not be used.

keywords.name: kwd:dowel-id
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by the dowel ID of an associated dowel. If this keyword is used, position , element-id , and node-id should not be used.

keywords.name: kwd:element-id
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by the element ID number. If this keyword is used, position , dowel-id , and node-id should not be used.

keywords.name: kwd:node-id
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by the node ID of one of its associated nodes. If this keyword is used, position , dowel-id , and element-id should not be used.
